statements.name: sql_insert_source
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_sources (name, kind, bus, address, mesh_source, rated_w, protocol)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_sources
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, kind, bus, address, mesh_source, rated_w, power_w, voltage_mv,
       current_ma, temperature_mc, status, protocol, updated_epoch
FROM energy_sources ORDER BY kind, name

statements.name: sql_find_source_by_name
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, kind, bus, address, mesh_source, rated_w, power_w, voltage_mv,
       current_ma, temperature_mc, status, protocol, updated_epoch
FROM energy_sources WHERE name = ? LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_update_source_reading
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_sources
SET power_w = ?, voltage_mv = ?, current_ma = ?,
    temperature_mc = ?, status = ?,
    updated_epoch = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_delete_source
statements.sql: DELETE FROM energy_sources WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_battery
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_batteries (name, chemistry, capacity_wh, can_profile, bms_host, mesh_source)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_batteries
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, chemistry, capacity_wh, soc_milli, soh_milli, voltage_mv,
       current_ma, temperature_mc, cell_min_mv, cell_max_mv, charge_limit_ma,
       discharge_limit_ma, can_profile, bms_host, mesh_source, status,
       updated_epoch
FROM energy_batteries ORDER BY name

statements.name: sql_find_battery_by_name
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, chemistry, capacity_wh, soc_milli, soh_milli, voltage_mv,
       current_ma, temperature_mc, cell_min_mv, cell_max_mv, charge_limit_ma,
       discharge_limit_ma, can_profile, bms_host, mesh_source, status,
       updated_epoch
FROM energy_batteries WHERE name = ? LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_update_battery_reading
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_batteries
SET soc_milli = ?, soh_milli = ?, voltage_mv = ?,
    current_ma = ?, temperature_mc = ?,
    cell_min_mv = ?, cell_max_mv = ?, status = ?,
    updated_epoch = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_delete_battery
statements.sql: DELETE FROM energy_batteries WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_grid
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_grids (name, utility, mesh_source, phases, import_limit_w,
                          export_limit_w, zero_export)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_grids
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, utility, mesh_source, phases, voltage_mv, frequency_mhz,
       import_w, export_w, import_limit_w, export_limit_w, zero_export,
       synchronized, status, updated_epoch
FROM energy_grids ORDER BY name

statements.name: sql_find_grid_by_name
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, utility, mesh_source, phases, voltage_mv, frequency_mhz,
       import_w, export_w, import_limit_w, export_limit_w, zero_export,
       synchronized, status, updated_epoch
FROM energy_grids WHERE name = ? LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_update_grid_reading
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_grids
SET voltage_mv = ?, frequency_mhz = ?,
    import_w = ?, export_w = ?,
    synchronized = ?, status = ?,
    updated_epoch = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_update_grid_zero_export
statements.sql: UPDATE energy_grids SET zero_export = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_delete_grid
statements.sql: DELETE FROM energy_grids WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_load
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_loads (name, zone, priority, power_w, critical)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_loads
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, zone, priority, power_w, critical, shed, state, updated_epoch
FROM energy_loads ORDER BY priority, name

statements.name: sql_find_load_by_name
statements.sql:
SELECT id, name, zone, priority, power_w, critical, shed, state, updated_epoch
FROM energy_loads WHERE name = ? LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_update_load_state
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_loads
SET state = ?, shed = ?, updated_epoch = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_update_load_reading
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_loads
SET power_w = ?, state = ?, updated_epoch = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_set_load_shed
statements.sql:
UPDATE energy_loads SET shed = ?, updated_epoch = ?
WHERE critical = 0 AND priority >= ?

statements.name: sql_delete_load
statements.sql: DELETE FROM energy_loads WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_get_config
statements.sql:
SELECT id, mode, grid_forming, zero_export, peak_shaving, tariff_optimization,
       reserve_soc_milli, load_shed_soc_milli, generator_start_soc_milli,
       generator_stop_soc_milli, charge_limit_ma, discharge_limit_ma,
       charge_voltage_mv, discharge_cutoff_mv, export_limit_w,
       solar_temp_limit_mc, battery_temp_limit_mc, source_over_voltage_mv,
       source_over_current_ma, battery_cell_delta_mv, grid_min_voltage_mv,
       grid_max_voltage_mv, grid_min_frequency_mhz, grid_max_frequency_mhz,
       generator, load_shed, tariff_peak, sim_fault, sim_tick,
       energy_today_wh, energy_total_wh, updated_epoch
FROM energy_config WHERE id = 1

statements.name: sql_update_config_policy
statements.sql:

    load_shed_soc_milli = ?,

statements.name: sql_set_config_mode

UPDATE energy_config

statements.name: sql_set_config_generator
statements.sql:

statements.name: sql_set_config_shed

statements.name: sql_get_fault_state
statements.sql:
SELECT code, active, severity, message, updated_epoch
FROM energy_fault_state WHERE code = ? LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_set_fault_state
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_fault_state (code, active, severity, message, updated_epoch)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
ON CONFLICT(code) DO UPDATE SET
    active = excluded.active,
    severity = excluded.severity,
    message = excluded.message,
    updated_epoch = excluded.updated_epoch

statements.name: sql_list_active_fault_states
statements.sql:
SELECT code, active, severity, message, updated_epoch
FROM energy_fault_state WHERE active = 1
ORDER BY updated_epoch DESC, code

statements.name: sql_insert_event
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO energy_events (severity, kind, message, created_epoch)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_events
statements.sql:
SELECT id, severity, kind, message, created_epoch
FROM energy_events ORDER BY created_epoch DESC, id DESC LIMIT 200

statements.name: sql_insert_category
statements.sql: INSERT INTO categories (name) VALUES (?)

statements.name: sql_list_categories
statements.sql: SELECT id, name FROM categories ORDER BY name

statements.name: sql_insert_item
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO items (name, category_id, unit, quantity_milli, reorder_milli,
                   location, notes)
VALUES (?, NULLIF(?, ''), ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_items
statements.sql:
SELECT i.id, i.name, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS category, i.category_id, i.unit,
       i.quantity_milli, i.reorder_milli, COALESCE(i.location, '') AS location,
       COALESCE(i.notes, '') AS notes
FROM items i
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = i.category_id
ORDER BY i.name

statements.name: sql_update_item_details
statements.sql:
UPDATE items
SET name = ?, category_id = NULLIF(?, ''), unit = ?,
    reorder_milli = ?, location = ?, notes = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_update_item_stock
statements.sql: UPDATE items SET quantity_milli = quantity_milli + ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_expense
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO expenses
    (item_id, item, category_id, quantity_milli, unit_price_cents, total_cents,
     source, purchased_at, comment)
VALUES
    (NULLIF(?, ''), ?, NULLIF(?, ''), ?,
     ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_expenses
statements.sql:
SELECT e.id, e.item, COALESCE(c.name, '') AS category,
       e.quantity_milli, e.unit_price_cents, e.total_cents,
       COALESCE(e.source, '') AS source, e.purchased_at,
       COALESCE(e.comment, '') AS comment
FROM expenses e
LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = e.category_id
ORDER BY e.purchased_at DESC, e.id DESC

statements.name: sql_delete_expense
statements.sql: DELETE FROM expenses WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_total_expenses
statements.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_cents), 0) AS total_cents FROM expenses

statements.name: sql_insert_movement
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO stock_movements
    (item_id, kind, quantity_milli, unit_price_cents, total_cents, source,
     occurred_at, comment)
VALUES
    (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
     ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_low_stock_items
statements.sql:
SELECT i.id, i.name, i.quantity_milli, i.reorder_milli, i.unit,
       COALESCE(i.location, '') AS location
FROM items i
WHERE i.reorder_milli > 0 AND i.quantity_milli <= i.reorder_milli
ORDER BY i.quantity_milli

statements.name: sql_insert_chore
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO chores
    (title, description, schedule_kind, schedule_value, interval_hours,
     usage_interval_hours, grace_hours, priority, next_due_epoch, enabled)
VALUES
    (?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
     ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_chores
statements.sql:
SELECT id, title, COALESCE(description, '') AS description, schedule_kind,
       COALESCE(schedule_value, '') AS schedule_value, interval_hours,
       usage_interval_hours, usage_accum_seconds, grace_hours, priority,
       enabled, next_due_epoch, snoozed_until_epoch, last_completed_epoch,
       created_at
FROM chores
ORDER BY enabled DESC, next_due_epoch, title

statements.name: sql_complete_chore
statements.sql:
UPDATE chores
SET next_due_epoch = ?,
    last_completed_epoch = ?,
    snoozed_until_epoch = 0,
    usage_accum_seconds = ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_completion
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO chore_completions (chore_id, completed_epoch, note)
VALUES (?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_snooze_chore
statements.sql: UPDATE chores SET snoozed_until_epoch = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_add_usage
statements.sql:
UPDATE chores
SET usage_accum_seconds = usage_accum_seconds + ?
WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_list_completions
statements.sql:
SELECT c.id, c.chore_id, ch.title, c.completed_epoch,
       COALESCE(c.note, '') AS note
FROM chore_completions c
LEFT JOIN chores ch ON ch.id = c.chore_id
ORDER BY c.completed_epoch DESC, c.id DESC
LIMIT 50

statements.name: sql_insert_widget
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO widgets (title, kind, source_kind, source, method, unit, points, position, size, decimals, created_epoch)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_widgets
statements.sql:
SELECT id, title, kind, source_kind, COALESCE(source, '') AS source,
       method, COALESCE(unit, '') AS unit, points, position, size, decimals, pinned, created_epoch
FROM widgets ORDER BY position, title

statements.name: sql_update_widget
statements.sql:
UPDATE widgets SET title = ?, kind = ?, source_kind = ?,
    source = ?, method = ?, unit = ?, points = ?, decimals = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_move_widget
statements.sql: UPDATE widgets SET position = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_resize_widget
statements.sql: UPDATE widgets SET size = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_pin_widget
statements.sql: UPDATE widgets SET pinned = ? WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_delete_widget
statements.sql: DELETE FROM widgets WHERE id = ?

statements.name: sql_insert_widget_value
statements.sql:
INSERT INTO widget_values (widget_id, value_text, value_milli, recorded_epoch)
VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)

statements.name: sql_list_widget_values
statements.sql:
SELECT * FROM widget_values WHERE widget_id = ?
ORDER BY recorded_epoch DESC, id DESC LIMIT 100

statements.name: sql_latest_widget_value
statements.sql:
SELECT id, widget_id, value_text, value_milli, recorded_epoch
FROM widget_values WHERE widget_id = ?
ORDER BY recorded_epoch DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1

statements.name: sql_list_telemetry_recent
statements.sql:
SELECT CAST(value AS TEXT) AS value_text, received_ms
FROM telemetry_reading
WHERE project = ? AND field = ?
ORDER BY received_ms DESC LIMIT 60

statements.name: sql_update_widget_source
statements.sql: UPDATE widgets SET source_kind = ?, source = ?, method = ? WHERE id = ?
